stem: Bluegrain Media expects unpredictable traffic spikes on a new DynamoDB table and wants minimal capacity planning overhead during launch.

choices.text: Run provisioned capacity with fixed RCUs and WCUs sized from prelaunch estimates.
Run provisioned capacity with auto scaling and switch modes several times each day.
Pre-purchase reserved capacity before traffic patterns are known.
Use on-demand capacity mode, billed per read/write request unit consumed.

rationale: On-demand capacity is designed for unpredictable traffic without upfront throughput planning. Fixed provisioned sizing requires accurate forecasting and can miss sudden spikes or waste capacity. Frequent mode switching is constrained and adds operational complexity. Reserved capacity is a commitment instrument better aligned to predictable provisioned usage.
